2609.05146.title: A Hybrid Predictive Ensemble of Machine Learning and Deep Neural Networks for Early Cardiovascular Disease Risk Assessment
2609.05146.paper_summary: This study introduces an intelligent framework that integrates machine learning and deep neural network ensemble techniques for early detection and prognosis of cardiovascular diseases. The system utilizes real-time physiological data collected from Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) devices, including ECG sensors, heart rate monitors, and blood pressure trackers. To ensure the accuracy and reliability of input data, preprocessing steps such as noise reduction, normalization, and missing value imputation are employed. The most significant health indicators are identified through effective feature selection methods and then processed using optimized classifiers such as Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forests, and eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), which are combined in an ensemble architecture to improve diagnostic precision. The framework demonstrates remarkable performance in predicting cardiovascular disease risk, achieving higher accuracy, reduced false positives, and enhanced consistency compared to conventional methods. It is designed on a cloud-based infrastructure that ensures scalability and real-time processing for continuous patient monitoring. Experimental evaluation on real-world cardiovascular datasets confirms the framework's efficiency in early-stage risk assessment and clinical decision support. The results highlight the potential of combining traditional machine learning and deep learning paradigms to achieve proactive healthcare management and improve patient outcomes.
2609.05146.paper_summary_zh: 這項研究介紹了一個智能框架，整合了機器學習和深度神經網絡集成技術，以便於心血管疾病的早期檢測和預後。<lb/>該系統利用從醫療物聯網 (IoMT) 設備收集的實時生理數據，包括心電圖 (ECG) 傳感器、心率監測器和血壓追踪器。<lb/>為了確保輸入數據的準確性和可靠性，採用了噪聲減少、正規化和缺失值插補等預處理步驟。<lb/>通過有效的特徵選擇方法識別出最重要的健康指標，然後使用優化的分類器進行處理，例如支持向量機 (SVM)、隨機森林和極端梯度提升 (XGBoost)，這些分類器在集成架構中結合以提高診斷精度。<lb/>該框架在預測心血管疾病風險方面表現出色，與傳統方法相比，實現了更高的準確性、減少的假陽性和增強的一致性。<lb/>它設計在基於雲的基礎設施上，確保可擴展性和實時處理，以便於持續的患者監測。<lb/>對現實世界心血管數據集的實驗評估證實了該框架在早期風險評估和臨床決策支持中的效率。<lb/>結果突顯了結合傳統機器學習和深度學習範式的潛力，以實現主動的醫療管理並改善患者結果。
